register: # Deye SUN-xK-SG series / Sunsynk hybrid inverters (single-phase and three-phase)
# Identical register map shared between Deye and Sunsynk branded units; also used by Sol-Ark
# Interface: Modbus RTU RS485 on COM/RJ45 port; 9600 baud 8N1; unit ID 1 (default)
# Also accessible via Modbus TCP (disabled by default; enable in inverter settings)
# RS485 wiring: RJ45 port on inverter; pins 7(A+) and 8(B-) for single-phase models
#   Three-phase models: verify pinout against model-specific manual
# Function code: FC03 (read holding registers); FC06 (write single); FC16 (write multiple)
# All values are uint16 unless noted; scaling factors listed in note column
# Register addresses are decimal; protocol document uses hex — add 1 to hex value for Modbus PDU
